source.title: Shinners & Mahler's Illustrated Flora of North Central Texas
source.authors: Diggs, G. M. Jr.; Lipscomb, B. L.; O'Kennon, R. J.
source.original_treatment_name: Aesculus arguta Buckley; historical synonym Aesculus glabra Willd. var. arguta (Buckley) B.L. Rob.

morphology_documented.habit: Shrub or shrubby small tree 7(–12) m under historical A. arguta concept
morphology_documented.leaves: Opposite and palmately compound (genus), 7–11 leaflets, each to 12 × 4 cm
morphology_documented.flowers: Cream to greenish yellow, calyx about 6 mm, petals similar, stamens nearly twice corolla length
morphology_documented.habitat: Limestone slopes and sandy open woods

source_scope_note: Historic taxonomic rank maintained; comparative key traits or family-only descriptions not automatically promoted to accepted species level.
unresolved_taxonomy_or_source_notes: Treat historical A. arguta account as var. arguta component of modern A. glabra, not whole species; hybrid Aesculus x bushii separately possible
preservation: Additive species source references only; no original records, photos, credits or galleries changed
